verdict.rationale: OpenHands explicitly supports event/webhook-triggered automations (schedules, webhooks, Slack mentions, PR labels, failed workflows, security alerts) that autonomously run agent actions, matching the 'rules triggering actions on events' story. Missing for 10: no first-party docs detailing a generalized rules-definition UI/config schema (only example automations are shown) and no independent/hands-on verification of these triggers working in practice.
